Added in T2.1a to close a UNC coverage gap identified in T2.1's tap-drill target seed set. Nominal diameter/TPI: identity data (verified, see provenance). Tap drill: source-bound, cross-validated against the T2-verified thread-engagement formula (Machinery's Handbook, ~75% engagement basis: 0.112 - 0.974/40 = 0.0877in, rounded to nearest stocked drill No.43 = 0.0890in). hex_head_in/clearance_hole fields left unavailable — not verified in this phase and atypical for hex-head fasteners at this size.

identity.source: Definitional: Unified numbered screw gauge formula (major_diameter = 0.060in + gauge_number x 0.013in); TPI is part of the ASME B1.1 designation itself.
identity.corroborating_source: Yamawa Co. technical reference No.078 (tap/threading tool manufacturer); AmesWeb chart citing ASME B1.1-2003

tap_drill_in.cross_check: Formula-consistent with the T2-verified Machinery's Handbook thread-engagement formula (~75% engagement target); not verified against a Tier 1 primary standard table (ASME B94.9 table content was not obtainable in this phase).

hex_head_in.note: No verified source obtained in this phase; hex-head format is atypical for numbered machine-screw sizes in common practice.

clearance_holes.note: No verified source obtained in this phase.
